title: MZ Problem with DreamX's Victory Aftermath Extension: "Cannot read property parent of undefined"

posts.author: Etrogade_
posts.body:
I've tried this out separately on a completely new project and this issue persists. When I try to use DreamX's Victory Aftermath extension, it always leads to this issue.
From what I understand. It had something to do with MV's code but I'm unaware how to fix it.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
"of undefined" always means that the engine was given a reference to a data object that does not exist.
why it didn't exist and what it is are the questions. It can be caused by deleting a database entry that is still in use somewhere. It can be because of a wrong configuration of a plug-in - basically you tell the plug-in to use something from a map or database that does not exist in your project.
Or it could be due to a wrong order of plugins or incompatibility between two plugins.
My guess would be a plugin problem, so we need screenshots of your plugin manager to see what plugins you have and in which order.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
I don't think that there is a solution at all.
with the test on the "clean" project it is extremely likely that DreamX and YEP Victory aftermath are simply incompatible to each other.
Most likely one of them changes the structure of the aftemath functions in a way that is incompatible with the changes from the other.
Best solution is probably to drop both and request a specific plugin for what you want to get.
